abstract:
Official Repo for RSS 2026 "DISC: Decoupling Instruction from State-Conditioned Control via Policy Generation"

# DISC: Decoupling Instruction from State-Conditioned Control via Policy Generation Official implementation of the RSS 2026 paper: **DISC: Decoupling Instruction from State-Conditioned Control via Policy Generation** > Hanxiang Ren, Pei Zhou, Xunzhe Zhou, and Yanchao Yang > Robotics: Science and Systems (RSS), 2026 ## 🔍 Overview DISC is a policy-generation framework that decouples high-level language instructions from state-conditioned low-level control. This repository provides training, evaluation, and test-time training code for reproducing the results reported in the paper. ## 🧩 Supported Task Suites - **LIBERO** - `libero_90` - `libero_spatial` - `libero_goal` - `libero_object` - `libero_10` - **Meta-World**: work in progress ## ⚙️ Installation Clone and install the modified LIBERO dependency: ## 📦 Data Preparation We use the OpenVLA version of LIBERO in our experiments. This version uses `256 x 256` image observations and filters out no-op actions. Please download the official LIBERO dataset from the [LIBERO repository](https://github.com/Lifelong-Robot-Learning/LIBERO), then convert it to the OpenVLA format using [`regenerate_libero_dataset.py`][openvla-regenerate-libero] from the OpenVLA repository. After downloading and converting the datasets, organize them as follows: ## 🚀 Training Train DISC on LIBERO-90: Train on other LIBERO suites: ## 📊 Evaluation Our checkpoints can be downloaded from [DISC Huggingface Repo](https://huggingface.co/ReNginx/DISC). Evaluate a trained checkpoint on LIBERO-90: ## 🔁 Test-Time Training Run test-time training (TTT) on LIBERO-90: ## 📝 Citation If you find this repository useful for your research, please consider citing our paper: ## 🙏 Acknowledgements This codebase builds on resources from the LIBERO, OpenVLA, and [HyPoGen](https://github.com/ReNginx/HyPoGen) projects. We thank the authors for releasing their datasets, environments, code, and tools. [openvla-libero-rlds]: https://huggingface.co/datasets/openvla/modified_liber
abstract_zh: 这是RSS 2026论文“DISC：通过策略生成将指令从状态条件控制中解耦”的官方代码库。DISC是一个策略生成框架，将高层语言指令与状态条件的低层控制解耦。本仓库提供训练、评估和测试时训练代码，用于复现论文中报告的结果。支持的任务套件包括LIBERO（libero_90、libero_spatial、libero_goal、libero_object、libero_10）和Meta-World（正在进行中）。安装时需克隆并安装修改后的LIBERO依赖。数据准备使用OpenVLA版本的LIBERO，采用256x256图像观测并过滤无操作动作。请从LIBERO仓库下载官方数据集，并使用OpenVLA仓库中的regenerate_libero_dataset.py将其转换为OpenVLA格式。训练和评估代码分别针对LIBERO-90和其他套件提供。检查点可从DISC Huggingface仓库下载。还提供了在LIBERO-90上进行测试时训练（TTT）的代码。本代码库基于LIBERO、OpenVLA和HyPoGen项目的资源构建。

>[!abstract] 一句话总结：DISC是一个策略生成框架，通过生成条件策略来解耦高级语言指令与状态相关的低级控制，在LIBERO等基准上训练和评估。


# 一、动机

> 现有机器人操作策略往往将高级语言指令与状态条件控制耦合，导致指令理解与控制策略难以泛化和组合。DISC通过将指令解码为策略生成过程，解耦两者，提高跨任务泛化能力。


# 二、方法

> DISC是一个策略生成框架，通过生成条件策略来解耦高级语言指令与状态相关的低级控制，在LIBERO等基准上训练和评估。


# 三、核心实验结果

> 论文在LIBERO-90、spatial、goal、object等套件上评估了DISC，但摘要未列出具体数值；总体表明解耦策略生成能有效处理多任务指令控制，具体指标需查阅论文或复现代码。


# 四、对我的启发

> 启发：解耦指令理解与低级控制是提升机器人操作泛化性的有效思路，结合测试时训练可进一步增强适应性；局限：当前仅完整支持LIBERO，Meta-World仍在开发中，且未提供跨本体实验，通用性有待验证。
